Name: Stardew Valley Reimagined 3
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#b4a7d6]★[/color] Yup, another one!! This works with Stardew Valley 1.5 and has a cleaner look than the previous iterations. It's also got new maps! [color=#b4a7d6]★[/color]
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GdasZDr.png[/img]

[list]
[*]All outdoor maps redesigned + 4 new ones
[*]70+ location messages on objects throughout the world
[*]Special forage areas that spawn uncommon and rare items
[*]A lot more hardwood stumps, trees, and berry bushes
[*]Access to previous inaccessible, unused areas
[/list][/size][/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2] 
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tpY0bg7.png[/img]
 
[list]
[*]All maps can be enabled and disabled individually in the [color=#d9d2e9]config.json[/color] file, so you can pick and choose which ones you want!
[*]The file can be found in the [color=#d9d2e9][CP] Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/color] folder and opened with any text editor, e.g. Notepad
[*]If the file is not there, run the game with SMAPI once to generate it
[*]Open the file, make your changes, save, then relaunch the game
[/list] 
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WRQ6OpX.png[/img]
 
[list=1]
[*]If necessary, remove any items you've placed around town
[*]Download this mod and also the [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-64#post-43678][color=#e69138][b]Reset Terrain Features[/b][/color][/url][color=#8e7cc3]﻿[/color] mod
[*]Make changes to this mod's config file now if there are some maps you want to disable
[*]Load up your save then press the L key to reset trees, bushes, grass, and debris on each map
[*]If you've unlocked the special orders board and a bush regrows over it, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304][b][color=#e69138]Destroyable Bushes[/color][/b][/url]﻿ to remove it
[*]Save the game by sleeping so you don't have to do all that again
[/list][/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][b] [/b]
[b] [/b]

[*]Download this mod + its requirements and extract [i]all [/i]folders out of the .zips into Stardew Valley/Mods. [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder][b][color=#e69138]Can't find it?[/color][/b][/url]﻿
